notes: People: 2021 Census, counted on 10 August 2021. Melbourne was in lockdown, so work-from-home and travel-to-work figures are unusual.
Pubs, bars, restaurants and bottle shops (Drink Out vs Drink In): the Victorian liquor licence list.
No Pokies line yet: the Victorian pokies list has venue names but no map locations; matching them to licences is still to do.

Grey areas: suburbs with fewer than 1,000 residents or fewer than 300 people per km² (parks, farmland, bush, airports, industrial land). The Census covers them, but they are left out so empty land doesn't count as much as busy suburbs. The grey areas on this map hold 224,520 people, 4.9% of the total.

explain.the-hi-vis-line:
What does "hi-vis" mean?

Hi-vis is Australian slang for the bright, high-visibility vests worn on building sites, roads, warehouses and delivery routes.

Here it means driving, machine and labouring jobs, compared with managers and professionals. It describes jobs, not people.
